one_line: Managed cloud MongoDB database service with cluster management, search, and vector/embedding APIs.
auth_notes: Atlas Admin API authenticates with a public/private API key pair or OAuth2 client credentials; database access uses MongoDB connection strings/credentials. API keys are created in the Atlas UI.
self_serve_notes: Free M0 tier cluster; any developer can sign up and generate Admin API keys solo, no sales.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Atlas Admin API covers projects, clusters, database users, backups, monitoring, search, data federation — 100+ endpoints.
api_surface.webhook_note: Atlas Triggers and alert third-party integrations can call external webhooks.

existing_mcp.note: Community MongoDB/Atlas MCP servers exist (e.g. mongodb-mcp-server); official MCP not confirmed.

evidence.note: Fetched text 'Atlas Programmatic Access' confirms the Atlas Administration API, CLI, Terraform provider, and Go SDK.

agent_notes: Admin API is purely for cluster/org admin; app-level data access is via MongoDB driver/connection strings.
